name: Above the Grid
description: High enough that the skyline stops being a place and starts being a diagram.

name: Spin Cycle
description: Forty minutes with nothing to do. That is when the best ideas print.

name: High Score
description: The machine does not care about her track record. Neither does she, right now.

name: Backseat Tape
description: Someone else is driving. She is still working.

name: Off the Clock
description: One bowl, no laptop open. It does not last long.

name: Under One Umbrella
description: Coverage for one. That has always been the arrangement.

name: Stairwell Bulb
description: The elevator is for people in a hurry to get somewhere nice.

name: Bench Work
description: If the board is not going to fix itself, somebody has to hold the iron.

name: Last Booth in Town
description: Nobody uses these anymore. That is exactly why it still works.

name: Next Train
description: The clock and the platform agree on one thing: she is early.

name: First Alarm
description: The night shift has a morning too. This is what it looks like.

name: Rooftop Cruiser
description: Four wheels, one ledge, zero committee approval required.

name: Legs Over the Edge
description: The height is not the point. The quiet up here is.

name: Counting Stars
description: No chart tonight is more honest than this one.

name: Palm on Glass
description: Checking if the reflection blinks first.

name: Kickstand Down
description: Parked for now. The engine has not decided that yet.

name: Closed, Browsing Anyway
description: The sign says closed. The door was not locked.

name: Off Duty, Mostly
description: The book is real. The phone is face-down, which is the actual accomplishment.

name: Railing at Altitude
description: Somewhere between the ground and the point of no return.

name: Underpass Streaks
description: The cars do not slow down for anyone's night shift.

name: Login Prompt, Take Two
description: Same desk, same terminal, a different question tonight.

name: Last Tower Before the Grid Ends
description: Somewhere out past the last signal, the lines keep going anyway.

name: Bath, Still Working
description: The desk followed her into the tub. It usually does.

name: H Marks the Spot
description: Nothing is landing tonight. The light stays on regardless.

name: One More Block
description: The desk can wait ninety more seconds.

name: Last Call, Not Ordering
description: In for the noise, not the drink.

name: Level Three, No Signal
description: Concrete does not carry a signal. Neither does an excuse.

name: Before the Open
description: The market has not woken up yet. She already has.

name: Bigger Fish
description: Something in here is also circling, patient, waiting for the right price.

name: Four Frames, One Take
description: The booth does not know she never smiles for the desk.

name: Meter Running
description: The fare keeps climbing. So does everything else tonight.

name: One Song, No Witnesses
description: The booth is soundproof. What happens in here does not make the tape.

name: Wrong Kind of Chart
description: Still reading the sky like it owes her a number.

name: Container Row
description: Her name stenciled on cargo that has nothing to do with her.

name: Yesterday's Print
description: She still reads the competition. Mostly to disagree with it.

name: Night Court
description: Nobody is keeping score except her, and she is losing on purpose.

name: Vestibule Glow
description: The machine takes forty seconds to load. So does everything else tonight.

name: Watering, Not Waiting
description: The one thing on the desk that grows without a catalyst.

name: On Air
description: The light is red. Everything after this is on the record.

name: Down Escalator
description: Going down does not mean giving up the desk.

name: Empty Screen, Full Lot
description: The feature has not started. She is early for once.

name: Hand on the Wheel
description: Nobody appointed her captain. Somebody had to steer anyway.

name: Break Shot
description: One clean break says more than a paragraph of thesis.

name: Truck Window
description: The only line she has ever waited in without complaint.

name: Gears, Close Up
description: Every deadline is just this, scaled up.

name: Split Conversion
description: The hard shots are the only ones worth remembering.

name: The Overlook
description: Somewhere between the ride and the exit line, the view was worth the wait.

name: Aisle Nobody Restocks
description: Everything you need is here. Nothing is labeled correctly.

name: Fountain Change
description: No coin thrown. She does not wish, she files.

name: Down the Hall
description: Whatever she is carrying, she is not explaining it tonight.

name: Her Move
description: She has been staring at this position longer than the clock allows.

name: Gate Side
description: Not flying anywhere. Just watching who is.

name: Heavy Bag
description: The bag does not talk back. That is the appeal.

name: Stacks, After Hours
description: The library closed an hour ago. Nobody told her.

name: Operator's Chair
description: Somebody has to run the machine that runs the skyline.

name: Basket, Half Full
description: Shopping like the desk will let her cook tonight. It will not.

name: Deck Crossing
description: The commute is the only part of the day nobody can rush.

name: House Lights Down
description: The film has not started. She came for the dark, not the movie.

name: Rack by Rack
description: Somebody else's story, still on the hanger, still for sale.

name: Loading Dock, 2 A.M.
description: Something is arriving. Nobody signed for it yet.

name: Under the Dome
description: A sky with no weather in it. Rare, and a little suspicious.

name: Rooftop Unit
description: The building breathes through this. So does the desk, some nights.

name: Bumper to Bumper
description: Every collision in here is on purpose, for once.

name: Under Safelight
description: Some prints still need the dark to come out right.

name: Older News
description: Sixty-six million years and it is still getting coverage.

name: Waterline
description: The tide does not care about deadlines either.

name: Listening Array
description: A whole field built to catch one signal worth hearing.

name: One More Loop
description: The ride ends where it starts. That is usually how the book goes too.
